notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Raise is currently being developed by two students, and we would like to inform everyone who has added the game to their wishlists that despite our time shared with university and other issues we have accumulated some progress and would like to announce them.


Recent progress

 "Bubu, The Choppa - Boss with axe" had a rework of its textures.
 The player will be able to equip Bubu's armor.
 We've prepared a basic VFX with dissolve shader for enemy kills.
 Victory and defeat screen have animations now.
 We prepared an animation framework for project maintenance.
 New animation finished - Directional Dash.
 Map lighting and ambiance will be in better contrast.
 We will support many different controls. (probably)



To do

 New main boss 2/3
 Inventory system working
 Skill tree working
 Level Design redone to allocate three bosses.


We hope to have more news soon, cya!

Engrave Studios
